title: Create the Status: Green campaign breakthrough proof
instruction: Read the TransformBy10X Ecosystem Brand Bible and Creative Execution Standard completely. Produce one campaign-level Work-lane hero image around a single idea: the official status is green while the physical evidence says the operation is failing. The image must feel like observed evidence from real work, not a software illustration. Stage it for human review only. Do not publish it and do not turn the visual choices into a permanent identity system.
deliverable: One staged 4K campaign image package for the Status: Green Work-lane concept, ready for the human 8+/10 creative gate.
acceptance_criteria: Both mounted creative authorities are read before evaluation.
The concept can be stated in one sentence: the status is green because the reporting system has become detached from the work.
The master is a verified native 3840x2160 PNG; low-resolution upscaling is rejected.
Desktop, mobile, and thumbnail derivatives are staged with the master.

The scene is photorealistic and built from operator-recognizable evidence: one clean reporting surface, one pristine green status signal, and a visibly broken operating layer beneath it with an unconnected handoff.
No logo, floating interface, glossy SaaS dashboard, humanoid robot, circuit-brain motif, neon cyberpunk treatment, or generated headline text appears in the image.
The visual has controlled tension, emotional specificity, usable negative space, and a deliberate crop on both desktop and mobile.
The render manifest records model, prompt, dimensions, hashes, references, and published=false.
Every mandatory self-evaluation category passes before the package is offered for human review.
The result remains provisional and unpublished until Erik gives an 8+/10 human approval.

constraints: Every visual choice serves the campaign idea.
Green is story evidence, not a permanent palette.
The system failure is the subject.

creative.defined_use: Provisional campaign hero art for the Work lane and campaign review; not a permanent identity lock.

inputs.creative_prompt: Create a native 4K, 16:9, photorealistic cinematic campaign photograph in a real project operations room just before dawn. Build one precise physical contradiction. ABOVE a long dark worktable, the room is unnaturally orderly and a single small industrial green stack light glows calmly on a plain black status box. BELOW the worktable, fully visible from a low three-quarter camera angle, the operating layer is failing: multiple real power and data cables split into messy improvised splices, crossed routes, temporary couplers, taped repairs, and one disconnected handoff cable hanging loose. A mid-40s operator crouches at that loose connection in side profile, still and observant rather than posed. The person is secondary; the split between the clean reporting surface and the broken operating layer is the subject. Make the scene believable enough to be photographed on a commercial set: correct gravity, correct cable tension, exact joinery, tactile metal, rubber, dust, subtle wear, deep natural shadow, and quiet blue early-morning window light. Sophisticated, precise, human, industrially weighted, and restrained. Compose for a campaign hero with deliberate negative space in the upper left for separately typeset copy and keep the green light plus loose connection inside a mobile-safe center crop. Use no paper, no documents, no sticky notes, no handwriting, no labels, no signage, no charts, no screens, no interface, and no visible words or letters anywhere. No floating objects, impossible geometry, surreal collage, glossy SaaS dashboard, hologram, humanoid robot, circuit brain, neon cyberpunk, generic corporate team, decorative technology, presentation-slide layout, logo, or headline inside the image. The green light serves this exact Status: Green campaign idea and is not a permanent brand color decision. The image will be paired separately with the line: The project is green. It is staged for human review and is not approved for publication.
